description: cfd_2d_heave_amr with G 42 0.2: the body is cast again on a grid when a vertex has moved more than 0.2 cells of that grid since its last cast, on the patches (cfd_amr_6dof::start_bodies) and on level 0 (sixdof_obj_cfd::fb_unchanged with the tolerance of G 42, patch AMR/0185); in between both keep the level set of that cast. The body lies inside the patch: the result is that of the cast on the patch alone, the ray cast and the reinitialisation on level 0 are left out at most stages (the 6DOF time of the run a third).
covers: sixdof_obj_cfd::fb_unchanged: the tolerance of G 42 on level 0
